# htmx-sse — shingo-edge/www/static/js/htmx-sse.js, the htmx SSE extension (classic script)
# Who connects through it (from the templates):
#   changeover.html #changeover-content: sse-connect "/events", hx-ext "sse", sse triggers: sse:order-update | sse:order-failed | sse:changeover-update
#   orders.html #orders-content: sse-connect "/events", hx-ext "sse", sse triggers: sse:order-update throttle:3s | sse:order-completed | sse:order-failed
# One page, steps in order, with #changeover-content as changeover.html writes it.

htmx processes the element (htmx:afterProcessNode)
    t=0 open #1 /events (withCredentials)
    #1 listens for: changeover-update, order-failed, order-update
#1 open
    t=0 event htmx:sseOpen on #changeover-content
#1 ← order-update {"id":1}
    t=0 htmx.trigger(#changeover-content, "sse:order-update")
    t=0 htmx.trigger(#changeover-content, "htmx:sseMessage")
#1 ← connected {"build":"b1"}; ← connected {"build":"b2"}; ← heartbeat {"build":"b3"}
    (nothing)
#1 error, readyState CONNECTING (the browser retries by itself)
    t=0 error event htmx:sseError on #changeover-content
    = no new stream within 10000 ms

## a fatal error (readyState CLOSED) and the retry ladder
#1 error, readyState CLOSED
    t=10000 error event htmx:sseError on #changeover-content
    t=10500 open #2 /events (withCredentials)
    = #2 opened, no stream closed before it
#2 error, readyState CLOSED
    t=10500 error event htmx:sseError on #changeover-content
    t=11500 open #3 /events (withCredentials)
    = #3 opened, no stream closed before it
#3 error, readyState CLOSED
    t=11500 error event htmx:sseError on #changeover-content
    t=13500 open #4 /events (withCredentials)
    = #4 opened, no stream closed before it
#4 error, readyState CLOSED
    t=13500 error event htmx:sseError on #changeover-content
    t=17500 open #5 /events (withCredentials)
    = #5 opened, no stream closed before it
#5 error, readyState CLOSED
    t=17500 error event htmx:sseError on #changeover-content
    t=25500 open #6 /events (withCredentials)
    = #6 opened, no stream closed before it
#6 error, readyState CLOSED
    t=25500 error event htmx:sseError on #changeover-content
    t=41500 open #7 /events (withCredentials)
    = #7 opened, no stream closed before it
#7 error, readyState CLOSED
    t=41500 error event htmx:sseError on #changeover-content
    t=73500 open #8 /events (withCredentials)
    = #8 opened, no stream closed before it
#8 error, readyState CLOSED
    t=73500 error event htmx:sseError on #changeover-content
    t=137500 open #9 /events (withCredentials)
    = #9 opened, no stream closed before it
#9 error, readyState CLOSED
    t=137500 error event htmx:sseError on #changeover-content
    t=201500 open #10 /events (withCredentials)
    = #10 opened, no stream closed before it
#10 error, readyState CLOSED
    t=201500 error event htmx:sseError on #changeover-content
    t=265500 open #11 /events (withCredentials)
    = #11 opened, no stream closed before it
    #11 listens for: changeover-update, order-failed, order-update
#11 open, then error, readyState CLOSED
    t=265500 event htmx:sseOpen on #changeover-content
    t=265500 error event htmx:sseError on #changeover-content
    t=266000 open #12 /events (withCredentials)
    = #12 opened, no stream closed before it

## the element leaves the page
#12 open; the element is removed from the body; #12 ← order-update {"id":2}
    t=266000 event htmx:sseOpen on #changeover-content
    t=266000 event htmx:sseClose on #changeover-content
    t=266000 close #12
a second page: #orders-content connected; removed; its stream errors CLOSED
    t=0 error event htmx:sseError on #orders-content
    t=0 event htmx:sseClose on #orders-content
    = no new stream within 200000 ms
a third page: #orders-content processed
    t=0 open #1 /events (withCredentials)
then htmx:beforeCleanupElement on it (htmx swapping it out)
    t=0 event htmx:sseClose on #orders-content
    t=0 close #1
